commands.name: hdi guide
commands.purpose: Display the local human onboarding entry point.

commands.name: hdi validate FILE
commands.purpose: Validate an HDI event JSON file and print its canonical digest.

adapters.name: oix
adapters.purpose: Verify and normalize a signed OIX v0.1 envelope.
important_limits: Does not establish factual accuracy or real-world identity.
Does not automatically trust discovered agent cards.

adapters.name: halloween_osint
adapters.purpose: Normalize a bounded Halloween OSINT evidence manifest.
important_limits: Manifest import does not read or re-hash referenced evidence files.

adapters.name: cyber_observatory
adapters.purpose: Verify and ingest Cyber Observatory evidence metadata received through OIX.
important_limits: Requires a matching, durably approved OIX inbox work item.
Approval gates ingestion only, not external side effects.

journal_backends.name: jsonl_reference
journal_backends.purpose: Simple event-ID-idempotent JSONL journal for a single writer.
important_limits: Do not share one JSONL journal between concurrent processes.
Invalid or truncated records are reported, not silently discarded.

journal_backends.name: sqlite_outbox
journal_backends.purpose: Transactional local event store and outbox for concurrent same-host workers.
important_limits: SQLite concurrency is limited to a local database file and host.
Does not provide multi-host replication, distributed consensus, or exactly-once external side effects.
Downstream consumers must deduplicate with stable event IDs.
Back up using SQLite-aware procedures, including WAL handling.

integration_demos.name: four_process_local_demo
integration_demos.purpose: Exercise one independent worker per upstream adapter against a shared local SQLite journal.
important_limits: OIX and Cyber verification values are synthetic test attestations, not cryptographic proof.
Does not start upstream services or establish WAN connectivity.
